approval_evidence.quote: NDA 209299 NDA APPROVAL ... TAVALISSE (fostamatinib disodium hexahydrate) tablets ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter ... ANN T FARRELL 04/17/2018

launch_evidence.quote: On May 29, Rigel launched TAVALISSE (fostamatinib disodium hexahydrate) for the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic immune thrombocytopenia (ITP)

notes: Rigel's TAVALISSE net product sales. 2018Q2-2022Q3 use the statement-of-operations line 'Product sales, net' in thousands (Tavalisse was Rigel's only product line then); 2018Q2 uses the release sentence (1.8). From 2022Q4 Rezlidhia sales enter the product total, so the brand figure is the release sentence. Ex-U.S. Tavalisse sales through Kissei, Grifols and Medison are collaboration revenue, not product sales. Q1 2018 printed no product sales, so 2018Q2 is the first quarter.
search_log: Bigdata.com search located Rigel's quarterly releases; all 2018Q2-2026Q2 quarters were taken from each quarter's own Item 2.02 EX-99.1 (data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0001034842; index.json for each accession).

2018Q3-2022Q3: 'Product sales, net' statement line (USD thousands) in each release, current-quarter column; the figures sum to the full-year statements (e.g. 2020 quarters 12,680+14,974+16,289+17,753 = 61,696; 2021 = 63,010).
2022Q4-2026Q2: release sentence 'TAVALISSE net product sales of/were $X million' (the statement line includes Rezlidhia from Q4 2022 and Gavreto from Q2 2024, so it is not the brand line).
Cross-checks: 2024 quarters 21.1+26.4+26.3+31.0 = 104.8 (printed FY 104.8); 2025 quarters 28.5+40.1+44.7+45.6 = 158.9 vs printed FY 158.8 (rounding of one-decimal figures, within 0.2).
Launch: 'On May 29, Rigel launched TAVALISSE' (2018-08-08 release). FDA approval letter NDA 209299 signed 04/17/2018 (appletter 209299Orig1s000ltr.pdf); openFDA original approval 2018-04-17.
Not found: no printed Tavalisse-specific line before 2018Q2 (pre-launch); no exclusion considered.
